sentences.quote: Cameron Bready - chief executive officer and member of the board of directors of Global Payments
sentences.text: Cameron M. Bready is chief executive officer and a member of the board of directors of Global Payments Inc.
(NYSE: GPN), the Atlanta-based payment technology and software company.
He was named president and CEO in May 2023, succeeding Jeffrey S. Sloan effective June 1, 2023, and joined the board at that time.

sentences.quote: Most recently, he was president and chief operating officer for Global Payments, overseeing the company's worldwide merchant solutions businesses across North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Latin America, along with worldwide operations, risk management, product and real estate. From 2014 to 2019, Cameron served as the company's senior executive vice president and chief financial officer.
sentences.text: He had served as president and chief operating officer since 2019, overseeing worldwide merchant solutions, global operations, risk management, product and real estate, after joining the company as senior executive vice president and chief financial officer in 2014.
Before Global Payments he was executive vice president and CFO of electric transmission utility ITC Holdings Corp., which he joined in 2009 after roles at Northeast Utilities and Mirant Corporation.

sentences.text: The completed Worldpay acquisition and the divestiture of Issuer Solutions to Fidelity National Information Services transform it into a pure-play commerce solutions provider, with expanded global reach and a client base spanning small businesses to global enterprises.
Its Genius point-of-sale platform is being extended into enterprise niches such as higher education and restaurants, including a collaboration with Uber Eats in the United States and Canada.
Installed scale is substantial: 51,000 restaurants and about 160 stadiums and venues worldwide use its enterprise technology.
Margins are high, at a 72.6% gross margin and 22.8% operating margin on $7.7B of trailing-twelve-month revenue.
